title: Jurisdiction legislation file
description: One file per legislative jurisdiction at data/legislation/<legis-id>.json. Produced by that jurisdiction's legislation-monitor agent, consumed by scripts/generate_report.py.

window_start.description: Start of the enactment window searched (YYYY-MM-DD).

window_end.description: End of the enactment window searched. The next run starts here.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id unique in the file (e.g., 'obbba-domestic-business-provisions'). One law may yield several entries when its provisions differ in category/impact.

law_citation.description: Public law / chapter / act citation once assigned (e.g., 'P.L. 119-21', 'Ch. 34, Stats. 2024').

status.description: 'verified' only when excerpt.passage was copied verbatim from a primary source retrieved this run.

summary_for_company.description: For an in-house corporate tax department: what this law changes for OUR returns/provision, what to do and by when. 2-5 sentences.

summary_for_firm.description: For an accounting firm: which clients are affected, what changes in preparation across the book of business, planning/communication points. 2-5 sentences.

affected_returns.description: Specific returns/forms touched (e.g., 'Form 1120', 'Form 5471 Sch. I-1', 'NJ CBT-100U'). Join key for future return-data comparison.

related_form_jurisdictions.description: Form-layer jurisdiction ids this law feeds into (e.g., ['federal-1120']).

first_return_year_affected.description: First tax year whose return changes because of this law. Join key for future return-data comparison.

document.description: Primary source title (enrolled bill, session law, agency summary).

passage.description: Verbatim operative language from the primary source. Powers the report's click-to-preview.

amended_from.description: The prior statutory text this passage replaces, verbatim, when showing the before/after is useful.
